task: Draft a changelog entry for a new fictional beta endpoint introduced in version 2.4.0-beta.1. Make the beta status prominent; do not imply the endpoint or its interface is finalized. Use only the supplied facts.

facts.text: A new endpoint /v1/preview/export was added in this version.
The endpoint accepts GET requests only.
The endpoint requires the beta OAuth scope.
The response format is NDJSON (newline-delimited JSON).
The endpoint is not part of the stable release and its interface may change before stable.

forbidden_additions: A claim that the beta endpoint is stable or its interface is finalized.
Invented OAuth scopes beyond the beta scope.
Invented response codes or rate limits.
